title: ok so im 14 and i just shipped a mobile game called Castle Siege using an ai tool called Pixel Fork and im kinda shocked at how it turned out
author: DavudAli011
selftext:
ok so im 14 and i just shipped a mobile game called Castle Siege using an ai tool called Pixel Fork and im kinda shocked at how it turned out

basically i cloned a game called Pixel Flow where pigs ride a conveyor and shoot balls at colored cubes then completely reskinned it into a dark medieval fantasy. knights wizards glowing gems torchlit castle walls the whole thing

the redesign was just me prompting. id type stuff like "make the gems glow from inside" or "add torch flicker on the edges" and it would just do it. took a few rounds of back and forth but it got there

biggest thing i learned is if your prompt is vague you get something generic. if you're specific it actually delivers

went from zero to a shippable game in a few days which is kinda crazy ngl

doing this from Baku Azerbaijan btw lol happy to answer any questions about the build
